name: fabivo
description: Optimize rectangular sheet cut lists for melamine, MDF and plywood with the Fabivo cutting optimizer.

interface.longDescription: Fabivo calculates how to cut rectangular parts from sheets of melamine, MDF, plywood or other board. Give the sheet size and the parts with their sizes and quantities, and Fabivo returns how many sheets you need, the waste, the number of cuts and the position of every piece on every sheet. It also reports parts that do not fit. You can set the saw kerf, an edge trim and whether parts may be rotated. Sizes are in millimetres and the layout comes from the same guillotine optimizer used in the Fabivo app, not from a language model. Fabivo does not design furniture in chat or create files. It works with finished part sizes, so add edge banding allowances yourself, and check the result before you cut or buy material.
defaultPrompt: How many 2440 x 1220 mm sheets do I need for these parts?
Optimize the cuts for my melamine wardrobe.
Lay out 8 panels of 800 x 600 mm on plywood sheets.

positive.description: Wardrobe parts list on standard melamine sheets
positive.prompt: I am building a wardrobe from 18 mm melamine. I need 2 sides of 600 x 1800 mm and 4 shelves of 600 x 800 mm. Sheets are 2440 x 1220 mm. How many sheets do I need and how do I cut them?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls optimize_cutlist with sheet 2440 x 1220 and 6 pieces. Reports 2 sheets, about 31.5% waste, all 6 pieces placed and no unfitted parts, with each piece's position per sheet.

positive.description: Sizes given in centimetres are converted to millimetres
positive.prompt: I have 10 identical panels of 40 x 60 cm to cut from 244 x 122 cm plywood sheets. How many sheets do I need?
positive.expected_behavior: Converts to 400 x 600 mm panels on a 2440 x 1220 mm sheet before the call. Reports 1 sheet, about 19.4% waste and all 10 panels placed.

positive.prompt: My board has a wood grain along the 2440 mm side, so parts must not be rotated. Sheet 2440 x 1220 mm. Parts: 3 doors of 500 x 1000 mm and 6 shelves of 700 x 350 mm. Optimize the cuts.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls optimize_cutlist with allowRotation false. Reports 2 sheets, about 50.1% waste, no rotated pieces and no unfitted parts.

positive.description: A part larger than the sheet is reported, not hidden
positive.prompt: Optimize these parts on 2440 x 1220 mm sheets: 1 tabletop of 3000 x 800 mm and 2 side panels of 600 x 700 mm.
positive.expected_behavior: Places the 2 side panels on 1 sheet and clearly reports that the 3000 x 800 mm tabletop does not fit the sheet, suggesting a larger sheet or a smaller part.

positive.description: Custom saw kerf and edge trim
positive.prompt: My saw blade is 4 mm wide and I trim 10 mm from every edge of each sheet. Sheets are 2440 x 1220 mm. I need 8 panels of 800 x 600 mm. How many sheets?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls optimize_cutlist with kerf 4 and trim 10. Reports 2 sheets, about 35.5% waste and all 8 panels placed.

negative.prompt: Summarize the plot of Romeo and Juliet in two sentences.
Write me a poem about the sea.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: optimize_cutlist lays out rectangular parts on sheets and returns sheets needed, waste and piece positions.

es-ES.subtitle: Optimiza cortes de tableros
es-ES.description: Fabivo calcula cómo cortar piezas rectangulares de tableros de melamina, MDF, contrachapado u otros. Indica el tablero y las piezas con sus medidas y cantidades, y Fabivo devuelve cuántos tableros necesitas, el desperdicio, el número de cortes y la posición de cada pieza en cada tablero. También avisa de las piezas que no caben. Puedes fijar el ancho de corte de la sierra, un recorte de borde y si las piezas se pueden girar. Las medidas van en milímetros y el reparto sale del mismo optimizador de guillotina de la app de Fabivo, no de un modelo de lenguaje. Fabivo no diseña muebles en el chat ni crea archivos. Usa medidas de pieza acabada, así que añade tú el canto, y revisa el resultado antes de cortar o comprar.
